title: INVENHO Small Medium Dog Bed, Rectangular, Washable, Orthopedic, Soft, Calming, Durable, Non-Slip Bottom, S (20 x 19 x 6 inches, 50.8 x 48.3 x 15.2 cm)

reviews.title: My pets love it
reviews.body: My dogs and cats love it!Great quality, good size. Comfortable and easily washable just in case. Let it puff up once removed from the package and within 2 hrs it’s ready to use. I bought a second one for my chihuahua baby. The small is still big.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 15 June 2026
reviews.author: Fabricio

reviews.title: Perfect doggy bed.
reviews.body: So comfy. Easy to wash and dry and doesn’t bunch up or lose its shape. My boy loves to sleep in it all day long.
reviews.author: TF

reviews.title: Very nice bed for our Toy Yorkshire Terrier puppy.
reviews.body: Perfect for our small 9 week old Toy Yorkshire Terrier Lulu. She has quickly taken to it. It feels well padded around the sides. The bed that she lies on ia also a nice texture and feels very soft underneath. She is sleeping very soundly on it. Great purchase.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 20 July 2026
reviews.author: Barry Flowers

reviews.title: Good quality bed - had to get my other dog his own
reviews.body: It folds right into shape. My dog absolutely loved it even though I originally bought it for my puppy while he’s in his crate since he seems to enjoy something with sides. Now I’ve bought two to accommodate both of my dogs and I’m happy I did. It’s good quality and very soft. It feels like it could be tossed in the washer on the gentle cycle but I’m sure it’ll be missing a lot of fibers after the fact.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 11 July 2026
reviews.author: Jessi

features: Comfort and safety: the four raised walls and the rectangular dog bed provide good support and cushion for the dog's head and neck, the super soft padding offers relief from joint and muscle pain. and allowing your puppy to have a comfortable and restful sleep. The low-edge design provides easy access for small and old dogs.

Ultra-soft material: the pet bed is covered in short, pink spiral faux fur and cozy suede fabric, soft and warm during winter and effectively retains your pet's body heat. The bottom and sides filled with thickened and eco-friendly PP cotton to create a breathable and comfortable sleeping environment, which keeps the dog off the floor, the plush surface is warm and cozy, in no time, your pet will snooze in the high comfort of this dog bed.

Size details: small dog bed for dogs up to 6.8 kg, the external dimension is 20" x 19" x 6"; medium bed for medium dogs up to 13.6 kg, the external dimension is 25" x 21" x 8"; large bed for large dogs up to 18.1 kg, the external dimension is 30" x 30.5" x 8". 2 x 61 cm. 0 x 9" ; XL dog bed up to 60lbs, the external size is 35" x 25" x 9"; XXL dog bed for large dogs up to 80lbs, the external size is 42" x 30" x 10"; please make sure to confirm the size.

Washable dog bed: durable and machine washable dog bed. Delicate cycle and carefully dried in a dryer directly after washing and do not air dry. Please use your hands to pat, shake the dog bed and wait for 1-2 days for it to return to a fluffy state before use.
Non-slip bottom: this calming dog bed is equipped with a non-slip bottom to keep the bed in place and keep your pets safe.
